name: China Electronics Technology Group Corporation 55th Research Institute (CETC 55)
zh: 中国电子科技集团公司第五十五研究所

evidence.summary: The US Entity List names it as “China Electronics Technology Group Corporation 55th Research Institute (CETC 55)”, one of the research institutes of China Electronics Technology Group Corporation (CETC). CETC is one of the state-owned defence-industry groups that SASTIND lists.

The US Commerce Department listed it in August 2018, finding reasonable cause to believe that it was involved in the illicit procurement of commodities and technologies for unauthorized military end use in China.
It belongs to CETC, which describes itself as a key state-owned enterprise administered directly by the central government.

sources.title: Addition of Certain Entities; and Modification of Entry on the Entity List (83 FR 37423, 1 August 2018)
